identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of ICP-248 in Subjects With Relapsed or Refractory Mantle Cell Lymphoma (APEX-06)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Single-arm, Multi-center, Open-label, Phase 2 Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of ICP-248 in Subjects With Relapsed or Refractory Mantle Cell Lymphoma

leadSponsor.name: Beijing InnoCare Pharma Tech Co., Ltd.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a single-arm, multi-center, open-label, phase 2 study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of ICP-248 in subjects with relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma.

conditions: Relapsed or Refractory Mantle Cell Lymphoma (MCL)

interventions.name: ICP-248
interventions.description: Eligible patients will receive ICP-248 orally as per the protocol

primaryOutcomes.measure: Overall response rate (ORR) according to Lugano 2014 assessed by the independent review committee (IRC)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: According to Lugano 2014: IRC and investigator assessed complete response rate (CRR)
According to Lugano 2014: IRC and investigator assessed disease control rate (DCR).
According to Lugano 2014: IRC and investigator assessed duration of response (DOR).
According to Lugano 2014: IRC and investigator assessed time to initial response (TTR).
According to Lugano 2014: IRC and investigator assessed progression-free survival (PFS) .
Adverse event (AE) assessed according to CTCAE v5.0 criteria
Functional Assessment Of Cancer Therapy-Lymphoma (Fact-Lym) and European Quality Of Life Five Dimension Five Level Scale Questionnaire (Eq-5D-5L).
Area under the plasma concentration versus time curve (AUC)

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ≥ 18 years old.
* Histopathologically confirmed MCL expressing Cyclin D1 and/or t (11;14) chromosomal translocation.Formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissues or sections for diagnosis must be provided. It is for the approval of pathological diagnosis by the central pathology laboratory.
* The patient was diagnosed with relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma, and the previous treatment needs to meet the following requirements:

  * Failure of at least one adequate prior line of anti-CD20-containing therapy;
  * Failure of at least one adequate prior line of BTK inhibitor (BTKi)-containing therapy.
* Failure of the last line of therapy.
* At least one measurable lesion according to the Lugano 2014 criteria,.
* ECOG performance status of 0-2 .

Exclusion Criteria

* Current or prior history of central nervous system (CNS) lymphoma.
* Prior use of BCL-2 inhibitors (e.g., venetoclax/ABT-199, etc.).
* Autologous stem cell transplantation or cellular therapy within 3 months prior to the first dose of ICP-248.
* Prior allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.
